findings.description: Hardcoded production API key found in source code.
Hardcoded API secret detected in source code. Secrets should be managed via environment variables or a dedicated secret management service.

reasons: The candidate code has been refactored to retrieve the API key from environment variables using os.environ.get, which resolves the security findings regarding hardcoded secrets.
The implementation correctly handles the case where the environment variable is missing by raising an EnvironmentError, ensuring robust behavior.
The code is clean, follows standard Python practices, and passes all provided tests.
The security and maintainability scores reflect the successful removal of hardcoded credentials and the adoption of standard secret management practices.
